_comment: Cards phase-rs is known or suspected to get wrong (docs/CARD-OVERRIDES.md). `npm run overrides -- triage --write` adds cards that independent agent reports name (status suspected) and appends report references; it never changes a status. People set confirmed (reproduced), not-a-bug (agents were wrong) or fixed (with fixed_in: the phase-rs server_version that fixed it). Games where a suspected or confirmed card was played, without an active override for it, get the known_issue_card engine flag (METHODOLOGY §5.6).

issues.summary: With the optional exile, the 2 damage hits the caster instead of the targeted creature's controller. Reproduced in a scripted sandbox game on 0.115.0 (6485512); fixed locally by the heated-argument override.
